capture_method: installed Linux release binary against loopback capture server, isolated PRIME_AGENT_CODING_AGENT_DIR and --session-dir, fake key, synthetic prompt
provider: custom models.json providers: capture-responses (openai-responses) and capture-completions (openai-completions)
notes: Only field presence and salted digest relations are recorded; raw session IDs, prompts, and Authorization are never stored.
openai-completions sent no session header and no prompt_cache_key by default.
openai-responses sent session_id and x-client-request-id equal to the session, plus prompt_cache_key.
The installed release exposes only before_provider_request (payload rewrite); there is no header-injection hook, so no X-NewAPI-Session-ID was produced.

relations.completions: no default session field and no header hook; a gateway affinity header would need client-side support
